narr: Heavy rain fell off and on throughout the first few days of September in the vicinity of a stalled frontal zone. A period of heavy rain during the morning of the 5th resulted in 1 to 2 inches in just a few hours across northern Oconee County, resulting in isolated flash flooding in the Chattooga River basin.
ev: County comms reported that a campground on Burrells Ford Rd at the Chattooga River was inundated with 2 to 3 feet of water and evacuated after 1 to 2 inches of rain fell during the morning of the 5th. This was on top of 3 to 5 inches of rain that had fallen across the area since the 2nd.
